verdict.rationale: Viam documents that data queues locally during network outages and low-bandwidth conditions, then syncs when connectivity returns, with restarts and storage constraints handled automatically (viam-docs-7). SDKs reconnect automatically when the network drops (viam-docs-70), and models run inference locally on the machine (viam-docs-9), which supports continued operation at the edge. A community comment that robot firmware needs internet access (viam-comm-3) is general and not a concrete hands-on failure, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that control logic keeps running while offline, details on buffer limits and sync-recovery behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
